title: canadas services pmi hits six month low trade tensions grow 2026 09 03
text:
TORONTO, Sept 3 (Reuters) - Canada's services economy contracted at its steepest pace in six months in August as rising trade tensions and geopolitical ​instability weighed on new business, S&P Global's Canada services PMI data ‌showed on Thursday.
The headline Business Activity Index fell to 46.8 last month from 49.1 in July, marking its lowest level since February. A reading below 50 indicates contraction ​in the sector.
